# The East Agency

> Independent insurance agency in Cartersville, Georgia, run by Brannon East. Serves families and businesses with auto, home, life, health, and business insurance by shopping 20+ carriers to find the best rate and coverage - licensed in 11 states.

The East Agency has been locally owned and operated in Cartersville, GA since 2015. As an independent agency (not captive to one insurance company), Brannon East and his team compare rates across 20+ carriers on behalf of each client at no added cost, rather than selling a single company's policies.

## Key facts

- Business name: The East Agency (also known as Brannon East Agency)
- Founder: Brannon East
- Founded: 2015
- Address: 47 Stonewall St, Cartersville, GA 30120
- Phone: (678) 562-6905
- Email: info@brannoneastagency.com
- Website: https://brannoneast.agency
- Licensed in: Georgia, Alabama, Colorado, Florida, Kentucky, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Washington
- Primary service area: Cartersville and Bartow County, Georgia, and the surrounding Southeast
- Reviews: 87+ reviews on Google, 5.0 average rating

## Products

- Auto insurance
- Home insurance
- Life insurance (term, whole life, indexed universal life, mortgage protection, final expense)
- Health insurance
- Business insurance
- Boat, motorcycle, RV, classic car, ATV/UTV, farm, pet, and travel insurance
- Landlord, renters, and flood insurance
